name: com.ganty/mcp-server
title: Ganty MCP
description: Gantt chart SaaS with server-side critical path calculation and dependency-aware shift-impact simulation. Tools include get_critical_path (CPM with slack + progress-aware remaining duration), reschedule_and_propagate (dry-run by default, commit in a single transaction), plus full CRUD over projects/tasks/milestones/dependencies.
